biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - De novo alterations in KLF7 are a novel cause of intellectual disability, psychiatric and neuromuscular issues. (ASHG 2016)
biological.summary: Three unrelated individuals with de novo missense variants in KLF7 (p.T137M, p.P139S, p.D264N) presented with intellectual disability, abnormal muscle tone, feeding/swallowing issues, psychiatric features, and neuromuscular issues. Two variants fall in the F-box motif involved in protein-protein interactions and ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis; one variant is in the zinc finger DNA-binding domain. KLF7 is implicated in neurogenesis including axon guidance in hippocampus, olfactory bulbs, and cortex.

biological.citation: KLF7 orchestrates hippocampal development through neurogenesis and Draxin-mediated neuronal migration. (PMID: 40762575)
biological.summary: Conditional knockout of KLF7 in hippocampal progenitors (Emx1-Cre;Klf7F/F mice) caused hippocampal shrinkage, disrupted neurogenesis, neuronal differentiation and migration, and led to anxiety/depression-like behaviors and memory impairments. Transcriptomic profiling identified Draxin, a neural chemorepellent, as a key downstream transcriptional target of KLF7. Overexpression of Draxin rescued dentate gyrus granule cell migration defects in KLF7 mutant mice.

biological.citation: KLF7-transfected Schwann cell graft transplantation promotes sciatic nerve regeneration. (PMID: 27826105)
biological.summary: KLF7 overexpression in Schwann cells via AAV2 promoted SC proliferation, enhanced DRG neurite outgrowth, and improved sciatic nerve regeneration in a mouse acellular nerve allograft model. KLF7-overexpressing SCs showed increased expression of NGF, GAP43, TrkA, and TrkB, suggesting involvement of neurotrophin signaling pathways. These findings confirm KLF7 as a transcription factor that stimulates axonal regeneration after peripheral nerve injury.

biological.citation: HMGB1-mediated elevation of KLF7 facilitates hepatocellular carcinoma progression and metastasis through upregulating TLR4 and PTK2. (PMID: 37554278)
biological.summary: KLF7 overexpression promotes HCC metastasis by directly transactivating TLR4 and PTK2 promoters. HMGB1 upregulates KLF7 via the TLR4/RAGE-PI3K-AKT-NF-κB pathway, forming a positive feedback loop. Genetic depletion of KLF7 via AAV gene therapy impeded HMGB1-mediated HCC progression and metastasis in orthotopic xenograft and DEN/CCl4-induced HCC models.

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes adipocyte inflammation and glucose metabolism disorder by activating the PKCζ/NF-κB pathway. (PMID: 37342904)
biological.summary: KLF7 directly binds the PKCζ promoter to upregulate its transcription, thereby activating the NF-κB signaling pathway and promoting IL-6 expression in adipocytes. In high-fat diet mice, KLF7, PKCζ, p-IκB, p-p65, and IL-6 were all elevated in epididymal white adipose tissue, while fat-conditional KLF7 knockout reduced these markers. This identifies a KLF7/PKCζ/NF-κB axis linking KLF7 to adipocyte inflammation and insulin resistance.

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes progression of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma by remodeling tumor immune microenvironment. (PMID: 41482204)
biological.summary: KLF7 acts as an oncogenic transcription factor in HNSCC that directly transcriptionally activates LOX, driving extracellular matrix crosslinking and stiffening to recruit tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) and suppress CD8+ T cell-mediated killing. In vitro and in vivo experiments showed KLF7 governs both autonomous malignant behaviors and macrophage recruitment in the tumor microenvironment. The KLF7/LOX/TAM signaling axis was validated as a potential therapeutic vulnerability in HNSCC.

biological.citation: Histone marks identify novel transcription factors that parse CAR-T subset-of-origin, clinical potential and expansion. (PMID: 39333103)
biological.summary: Analysis of histone methylation marks in CAR-T products from a clinical lymphoma trial (NCT01865617) identified KLF7 activity as associated with in vivo CAR-T accumulation in patients. Overexpression of KLF7 in CAR-T cells increased in vitro proliferation and IL-2 production. This represents a novel functional role for KLF7 in T cell biology beyond its known roles in neural and cancer contexts.

biological.citation: Knockdown of KLF7 inhibits the differentiation of both intramuscular and subcutaneous preadipocytes in goat. (PMID: 34890305)
biological.summary: KLF7 knockdown in goat intramuscular and subcutaneous preadipocytes inhibited lipid droplet accumulation and reduced expression of adipogenic markers (C/EBPα, SREBP1), demonstrating KLF7 as a positive regulator of adipogenesis. KLF7 expression changed dynamically during preadipocyte-to-adipocyte differentiation, and KLF7 transcriptional binding sites were identified in the promoters of multiple KLF family members and adipogenic markers. This contrasts with some prior reports and identifies KLF7 as a novel regulator of adipogenesis in a livestock model.

biological.citation: KLF7 Blocks MKNK2/HIF-1 Pathway-Mediated M1 Microglia Polarization to Ameliorate Ischemic Stroke-Induced Neurological Injury. (PMID: 40923147)
biological.summary: KLF7 expression is downregulated in ischemic stroke (MCAO/R rat model and OGD/R microglia), and KLF7 overexpression ameliorated brain damage and neurological injury by repressing MKNK2 transcription, thereby inhibiting HIF-1 signaling and M1 microglia polarization while promoting M2 polarization. ChIP and dual-luciferase assays confirmed direct KLF7-mediated repression of the MKNK2 promoter. MKNK2 overexpression reversed the neuroprotective effects of KLF7 overexpression in vivo.

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - Cardiovascular comorbidity influence genetic association studies results. (ASHG 2016)
biological.summary: A genetic association study of cardiovascular disease comorbidity identified a KLF7 polymorphism as associated with a combination of multiple cardiovascular diseases including ischemic heart disease, arterial hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypercholesterolemia (disease syntropy phenotype). KLF7 was not associated with isolated ischemic heart disease or the two-disease combination, suggesting its variant is specific to the multi-disease comorbidity context. Approximately 1,400 polymorphic variants were analyzed across patient groups.
